aboutText: I’m Riya, founder of Riya Desk, and I help businesses become the brand people choose. With 7+ years of experience and an MBA from the UK, I get to the heart of your business challenges and combine strategy, creativity and AI to turn what makes you different into a reason customers notice, trust and buy from you.

services.name: Brand Strategy
services.desc: Find the one thing only you can own. I dig into your business, your audience and your competitors to shape the positioning, messaging and story that make choosing you feel obvious.

services.name: Social Media Marketing
services.desc: Turn scrolling into following, and following into buying. A clear platform plan, content that sounds like you, and AI-assisted planning that keeps you consistent without wearing out your team.

services.name: Campaign Concepts
services.desc: Big ideas with a clear job to do. Launches and campaigns built around one sharp insight, carried through every channel so people notice, remember and act.

services.name: Website Design, Strategy & Development
services.desc: A website that works as hard as you do. From structure and messaging to design and build, every page is planned to turn visitors into enquiries.

services.name: Business Consulting
services.desc: Clarity before campaigns. With an MBA and 7+ years of hands-on experience, I help you untangle growth challenges, sharpen your offer and build a practical plan your team can act on.

services.name: IT Services
services.desc: The tech behind your brand, handled. Domains, hosting, business email and the tools your team relies on, set up properly, connected together and kept running smoothly.

services.name: AI Solutions
services.desc: Put AI to work where it actually saves time. Custom workflows for content, research, customer support and reporting, so your team spends less time on busywork and more on what matters.

strategies.name: Insync
strategies.text: Launch plan for a couple-tee brand, built so every post has a job.

strategies.name: Wedding Lensation
strategies.text: Ten million Reel views, 3,463 followers. A plan to turn reach into recall.

concepts.name: Fernhouse Pilates
concepts.text: A one-page journey that turns Instagram curiosity into a booked first class, with an offer built around the beginner’s real fear.

concepts.name: Halfmoon Tiffins
concepts.text: One offer, three hooks: money, home and time. Three paid social ads with audiences, a three-round test plan and a measurement plan.

concepts.name: Velline
concepts.text: A luxury hair and skin atelier. A redesigned journey from Instagram follower to first booking to private client, built on being remembered rather than discounts.

contactInvite: Have a brand to grow, a launch to plan or a problem worth solving? Let’s work together.
heroIntro: Brand strategy, creative marketing and AI solutions for businesses ready to grow.
